answer: Anyone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The island counter is kept in shale and haven reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1330 identities would post 837 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
